dev.deploy-bot: Finished rollout of model v2.3.2 to hosted pool A (canary 10%) :rocket:
kevin: seeing a spike in p95 on instances in pool A, alerted by SLO watcher. baseline p95 ~60ms -> ~420ms since 10:15 UTC
anya: confirmed on my dashboard, throughput down ~28% for that pool and overall token/sec dropped. KV hit rate fell from 98%->72% (per prom).
sre-ops: noisy-tenant alerts firing on host-3, high GPU SM stalls reported. Could be co-located job + new model sequence patterns.
kevin: profiler dump attached (short):
```
# top kernels by time (canary-host-3)
matmul_opt_kernel_512   34.2s
attention_stream_v2     18.7s
kv_cache_update         12.4s
softmax_reduce          6.9s
```
kevin: flame graph shows large stalls in kv_cache_update when sequence len grows beyond 256, and matmul_opt_kernel_512 used for many batches with seq=320 which is suboptimal.
ryan: model v2.3.2 changed tokenizer -> longer average sequence length (median 64 -> 312). rollout note mentioned tokenizer tweak but we didn't simulate seq-dist that skewed that much.
maria: that explains kernel selection: auto-kernel chooser picks kernel based on bucketed seq_len stats we ship with model. If median jumps, the chooser picks 512-optimized kernels which have bad performance at 320 due to tiling mismatch.
anya: also seeing KV cache eviction churn: many more distinct prefixes now, KV write amplification up 3x. hot-key skew on some tenants.
kevin: quick mitigation suggestions:
- rollback v2.3.2 from pool A (canary) -> reduces p95 back to baseline in ~2 minutes
- pin kernel selection to previous kernel for this model: `export MODEL_KERNEL_OVERRIDE=v2.3.1-kernelA` (works per-host)
- temporarily throttle noisy tenant on host-3
- tweak batcher to enforce seq_len cap per-batch so we avoid mixing 320 with 64 in same kernel decision
anya: I tried pinning kernel on one canary host, p95 dropped to ~110ms but throughput still ~15% below baseline. KV churn still hurting.
sre-ops: I'm isolating noisy tenant, moving it off host-3 now. also bumping KV cache size on canaries + enabling slower but more cache-friendly eviction policy (`--kv-eviction=LRU-slow`) for pool A for the next hour.
ryan: for a longer fix we should: add per-model seq-dist telemetry to the rollout checker, run synthetic seq-dist sims during canary, and make kernel-chooser aware of distribution variance (not just median).
kevin: Agreed. I'll open a small RFC for chooser heuristics. Also adding a perf test to CI that runs kernels at seq lengths {64,128,256,320,512} and records relative slowdown.
maria: Logging note: let's keep this thread for timeline. Can we capture exact Prom queries used? kevin, can you drop them here?
kevin: sure — key queries:
```
# p95 latency by pool
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, pool))
# kv hit rate
sum(rate(kv_hits_total[5m]))/sum(rate(kv_requests_total[5m])) by (pool)
# kernel usage
sum(rate(kernel_exec_time_seconds_total[5m])) by (kernel, host)
```
anya: rolling back canary now. deploy-bot: `rollback model v2.3.2 in pool A`
dev.deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for model v2.3.2 in pool A — expected convergence ~3m :white_check_mark:
kevin: after rollback p95 back to ~62ms, throughput recovered to -2% (normal variance). KV hit rate back to 97%.
ryan: next actions (owners):
- kevin: RFC for kernel-chooser heuristics + CI perf matrix (ETA EOD tomorrow)
- anya: add seq-dist synthetic checks to rollout verification (ETA 2 days)
- sre-ops: KV eviction tuning and noisy tenant isolation docs (ETA today)
- maria: add notes to rollout checklist about tokenizer churn and seq-dist testing
anyone: objections?
anya: no objections. adding follow-ups to the incident ticket. :+1:
maria: thanks all — good catch on the seq-dist interaction. we'll be more conservative on tokenizer changes during rollouts.
